# Tab-close pointer fixture provenance

`tab-close-pointer-contract.json` is an original Chromarchy interaction
contract authored for this repository. It is not copied from another editor or
external product.

Three documents are the minimum needed to close a non-current middle tab while
observing deterministic successor focus. The 300,000-pixel dimension reuses
Chromarchy's established sparse-canvas limit. The 100-millisecond synchronous
dispatch ceiling excludes user decision time inside the modal prompt and
matches the existing metadata-only UI interaction scale.
